title: Per-call cancellation binding for persistent resource sessions
api_or_output: Nonpublic BindCancellationToken(CancellationToken token) preserving existing resolver session methods and public APIs

acceptance.description: Add exact per-call cancellation binding to an idle persistent resolution session; preserve constructor behavior, independent budget cancellation, all counters/handles/active URI keys and public APIs. Reject busy/reentrant/disposed/faulted binding; canceled binding faults and drains while preserving original exception/token.

Actual sync/async tests prove exact tokenB reaches resolver/async stream after tokenA, cancellation and primary exception preservation with all accepted resources disposed once, paused/resumed session state retains aggregate quotas/cycles/parent handles; old constructor-token behavior remains passing.

Demonstrate corrected session boundary using only verified dependencies, compiled internal-hook inventory and unchanged public API, meaningful allocation/performance evidence for successful binding, complete cumulative predecessor/provenance/package/planning checks at known source; no core consumer implementation claim.

handoff.summary: Independent production entity source review at27c1 found persistent session captures first Append token; core permits different resume tokens. Consumer released own JSON to coordinator; independent scoped work continues without using unverified repair.
requests: Core owner binds existing session once per Append after setting activeCancellation before pending work; new sessions already receive currenttoken. No stable CTS bridge/token identity substitution, no shared budget replacement.
